paintings.title: Blue Boats
paintings.alt: Two blue rowing boats drawn up on pale sand, with cottages and dark trees on the bank behind them.

paintings.title: Boats at the Cove
paintings.alt: A pink and a grey-green boat resting on soft pink sand below a headland of white cottages, with green sea beyond.

paintings.title: Red Boat
paintings.alt: A red upturned boat in the foreground of a sheltered harbour, two fishing boats on blue water and a cottage under green hills.

paintings.title: Church by the Sea
paintings.alt: A small pale church on a far shore across still water, seen over deep green marshland flecked with wildflowers.

paintings.title: Fields on the Hill
paintings.alt: A patchwork hillside of pink, green and yellow fields, with fence posts running along the ridge under a pale sky.

paintings.title: Summit
paintings.alt: An abstracted green hillside broken into soft blocks of moss, lime and dusty pink, with a pale track falling through the middle.

paintings.title: Through the Dunes
paintings.alt: A dune landscape worked in cream, chalk blue and olive, with thin runs of paint falling down the surface like rain.

paintings.title: Saint, Sand and Sea
paintings.alt: A pale dune rising to a ridge, painted in soft pinks and cream with olive grasses and scattered dark marks.

paintings.title: Untitled (Green Valley)
paintings.alt: A deep green valley of layered fields and hedgerows, with flashes of rust and lilac among the greens.
